## Summary

Did 4.2 and staged the 0.30.0 release; only the publish is left, which the user runs. SPEC gained a Driver acceptance entry naming what 4.1 exercised — one session per launch or a recorded stall, reasons from the fold, a surface written and read back per launch, a stop that always lands behind a start, and the preflight refusals that leave no run behind — plus what this session's review added: a bounded wait, a guaranteed stop note, temp dirs gone at exit, and budgets that bound a driver rather than a run. It closes on 4.1's measured numbers rather than restating the design. README gained the drive row and a Working unattended section stating the two things an operator must know before leaving it running: sofar can only widen their own permission configuration, never narrow it, and the cost and session caps restart if a run is resumed. Version bumped to 0.30.0 in package.json and the lock; build, typecheck and pack verified at 29 files and 394 kB, no .sofar in the tarball, full.js present, and the built CLI reports 0.30.0 and carries drive. Release gate checked first: commit-attribution closed 2026-08-13, so M7's hold is lifted. The release also carries no-bind-durability, digest-signal and the TypeScript 7 toolchain. One thing found and NOT fixed because it belongs elsewhere: reach-index 3.5's render test flakes about 1 run in 25, failing on the provenance label 'logged alpha D1' while the event citation above it still passes, so the decision a traversal names is order-dependent where two decisions are appended in the same millisecond. It sits in record-index code this release does not touch and already shipped in 0.29.0, so it is pre-existing rather than a regression — but the suite is not honestly green until someone fixes it.
